gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto X part 3 records. Stillness is the encounter-specific name for the Japanese Stop alias. Same-name skills remain separate across phases. Preservation is the status, while Conservation remains in passive names and Tremor - Conservation. Unknown Power values, conditional Coins, Excision, temporary Shields, nail selection penalties, phase healing, replenishment conditions, and ally-dependent survival are retained. Encounter realms are described by order. Non-decaying Shield describes the persistent barrier property.

name.text: The Warden and the Chaplain (Canto X, Route C)

stageName.text: Sisyphus Department Store C: FATE LOST

lead.text: A long battle progressing from the Warden to the Chaplain. Destroy the candles first, then assign major clashes according to each turn's Stillness and Thumping Pulse. Against the Chaplain, avoid selecting Attack Skills pierced by nails. Let Meursault handle the final Shift + Delete while keeping other survivors alive.

listLead.text: A long battle through successive forms. Destroy candles first, then assign major clashes using Stillness and Thumping Pulse each turn. In the final form, avoid nailed Attack Skills. Let Meursault receive Shift + Delete while keeping other allies alive.

statNote.text: A special Route C battle. The body is Lv. 90 in every phase, with 3,660 max HP and base Defense Level 80. Phase 1 starts at 1,830 HP and 30 SP; transition to Phase 2 fully heals it. At 1 HP in Phase 2, it becomes the Chaplain and fully heals again. Phase 2 Stagger positions are unconfirmed. Candles are Lv. 1 with 59 HP and Defense Level 1. Each body slot has 2 slot weight. Aim for Customer Lv. 65, separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.

skillNote.text: Skills sharing a name have different values and effects across phases. Displayed Power for Phase 1 Atone. and Phase 2 Receive thy punishment. is unconfirmed. Unbreakable conversion from Divinity of the Obsidian God is conditional and is not added to fixed Coin icons. Excision Coins are shown through labels and effects. The Chaplain's collective nail notation “~” is shown alongside Implements of Confession.

priorities.0.text: In Phase 1, destroy all candles with fast Sinners. Assign a Sinner with at least 2 Speed to clash with the Warden.

priorities.1.text: Win the major area clash with Stillness, then Death Unto the Condemned or Systemwide Ban with Thumping Pulse.

priorities.2.text: Choose skills manually against the Chaplain. Have Meursault take Shift + Delete at the end and keep other allies alive.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Everyone's Speed fell to 1 early on

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Each surviving candle applies 2 Bind to everyone next turn. Use fast Sinners to destroy all candles before clashing with the Warden. A main target at 1 Speed greatly strengthens him; do not simply choose your slowest Sinner.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: The major clash requires far too much Power

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Stillness gives the Phase 2 and 3 major area skills −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power. Change the recipient first. You can also make Voice B's Sloth skill act after the normal skills to consume all Preservation Count, but this does not work if Count is replenished at the next Turn Start.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: I won against Death Unto the Condemned or Systemwide Ban but still died

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Both retain a Coin after losing the clash and deal fixed damage equal to 200% max HP. Winning with Thumping Pulse grants a temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP to absorb it. An ordinary Sinner winning through high Power alone is insufficient.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: Selecting a skill caused damage and nails

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: In Phase 3, equipping an Attack Skill pierced by a nail on the panel incurs a penalty. Avoid Win Rate and Damage auto-selection; choose an unpierced skill, or change it to defense or E.G.O before equipping it. Changing an equipped skill back to its original attack triggers the penalty again.

troubleshooting.4.symptom.text: I removed half his HP but he fully healed

troubleshooting.4.advice.text: The first time the Chaplain falls below 50% HP, he fully heals and removes negative effects. After reducing him to half again, the battle continues without another heal. Treat dramatic turn-display changes as an effect rather than normal turn progression.

troubleshooting.5.symptom.text: I cannot avoid the final lethal skill

troubleshooting.5.advice.text: After gaining a Shield at 33% HP or less, he uses Shift + Delete. Clash with Meursault and use The Stranger's 1 HP protection. It requires at least one other ally alive, so do not leave Meursault alone.

phases.0.timing.text: Before entering the special FATE LOST battle

phases.0.title.text: Prepare Customer Lv. 65, SP, and resources

phases.0.steps.0.text: Shop toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank on Route C. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level; experience levels gained outside it do not carry in.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Bring Meursault, HP and SP recovery, and high-Power E.G.O. E.G.O resources are halved on entry, but candle destruction in Phase 1 and phase transitions replenish them. If needed, gather SP and resources in the earlier 1F dungeon battle with Le Khaki.

phases.0.steps.2.text: In the preceding Warden encounter, attack glowing candles, then lure his attack into them to stun him. Retreat when in danger and break candles to heal. Reducing him to 1,830 HP starts the dungeon battle.

phases.0.steps.3.text: At the start of the dungeon battle, Sinners' SP recovers up to 30. Do not mistake this for an effect that lowers higher SP.

phases.1.title.text: Destroy every candle and clash at 2 Speed or higher

phases.1.steps.0.text: Two candles appear initially, with more summoned on later turns, up to four at once. Each has 59 HP and all resistances at ×2; split fast Sinners' attacks to kill them first. Candles targeted secondarily by area skills take 50% less damage, so check for survivors.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Surviving candles strengthen the Warden's skills and apply Bind to everyone next turn at Turn End. Destroy all of them every turn before focusing damage on him.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Assign a Sinner with at least 2 Speed who acts after candle cleanup to clash with the Warden. A main target at 1 Speed can trigger all-Unbreakable Coins, +2 Final Power, and +100% damage.

phases.1.steps.3.text: On turn 3, use a high-Power skill against Divine Retribution. That turn, Sinner hits inflict Clash Power Down on the Warden, so landing other attacks first helps. Phase 2 begins at 1 HP or less, or at the end of turn 3.

phases.2.title.text: Check Stillness, Thumping Pulse, and nails before major attacks

phases.2.steps.0.text: The Warden fully restores HP and SP and removes negative effects. Preservation Potency and Count carry over. The normal cycle then repeats Voice A → Voice B → Divinity A → Divinity B.

phases.2.steps.1.text: At Turn Start, identify Sinners with Stillness and Thumping Pulse. Handle normal attacks in Voice A; the Stillness holder can increase damage by assigning the Defense Skill slot as their main target.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Assign Voice B's Sloth skill Judgment to a Sinner with few nails. Give relatively weak Pride skills to those with many nails, and heal SP lost to Sinking.

phases.2.steps.3.text: If possible, make Judgment act after the other normal skills. It consumes all Preservation Count gained by the Gloom and Pride skills, helping prevent the next major skill's Coin Power buff. However, automatic Count replenishment next turn can prevent this weakening.

phases.3.title.text: Use Stillness for the major Judgment clash and Thumping Pulse for execution

phases.3.steps.0.text: Divinity A brings Judgment... Sentencing... Condemnation! It is clashable regardless of Speed; assign a high-Power skill from the Stillness holder for −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power on the enemy.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Winning reduces damage by 75% and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage, but remaining Coins still activate nail effects. Other Sinners with Hammernail [Judgment] can equip defense to halve the nail's fixed damage and prevent death or Stagger from that effect. The major skill itself does not activate Defense Skills.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Next turn, assign Death Unto the Condemned to the Thumping Pulse holder. It cannot be redirected normally, but that holder can clash regardless of Speed. Thumping Pulse gives the enemy −15 Clash Power; win to gain the temporary Shield.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Death Unto the Condemned has one Unbreakable Coin that deals fixed damage equal to 200% max HP On Hit. The 250% max HP Shield from a Thumping Pulse clash win is needed; an ordinary recipient merely winning is insufficient.

phases.3.steps.4.text: Other Gloom and Pride skills also become Unbreakable during Divinity. Account for nails remaining into the next cycle, and prepare high-Power E.G.O for whoever receives Stillness. The turn may end at 50% body HP or less; at 1 HP or less, Phase 3 begins.

phases.4.title.text: Avoid panel nails and keep the same two roles

phases.4.steps.0.text: HP and SP fully recover and negative effects are removed; Preservation carries over. The Chaplain keeps the same plan: Stillness for the major area clash, Thumping Pulse for the following Gluttony skill.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Every turn, check Attack Skills pierced by nails on the panel. Do not equip them or use Win Rate or Damage auto-selection. Change a skill to defense or E.G.O before equipping it to avoid the selection penalty. Beware of changing it back to the original attack while still equipped.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Phase 3 nails are called Implements of Confession. Console, Breakpoint, and Exception have different effects. Stacked Console causes self-damage when landing attacks; check nails on Sinners too.

phases.4.steps.3.text: Win against Do you seriously mean to break the Sisyphe System? with Stillness. Alongside its Power reduction, all targets gain a temporary Shield and winning gives 90% reduction. Do not reuse Phase 2's 75% value.

phases.4.steps.4.text: Win the following Systemwide Ban with Thumping Pulse. The Excision Coin remains after winning, but the temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP absorbs the 200% fixed damage.

phases.4.steps.5.text: If both Preservation Potency and Count are below 10, replenish 5 Count at Turn Start. Just after transition, emptying Preservation during Voice B may not prevent the next major skill's buff.

phases.5.timing.text: Chaplain below 50% HP for the first time, then half again

phases.5.title.text: Push through the first full heal and keep attacking after the effects

phases.5.steps.0.text: The first time the Chaplain falls below 50% HP, he fully heals and removes negative effects. This is not a failed transition; repeat the Stillness and Thumping Pulse plan to damage him again.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Do not count the dramatic turn-display change as ordinary turn progression. Buffs and debuffs do not suddenly stack by the displayed number of turns.

phases.5.steps.2.text: When reduced to half again, the battle continues without a full heal after the Sapling of Light LUXURIA effect. Keep damaging him rather than waiting for a special buff.

phases.6.title.text: Take Shift + Delete with Meursault and push through the Shield

phases.6.steps.0.text: The Chaplain consumes Sisyphe System Preservation to gain a non-decaying Shield equal to (25 + consumed Stack)% max HP. Defense Level permanently decreases by the consumed amount.

phases.6.steps.1.text: Shift + Delete joins the Voice A actions. It prioritizes Sinners other than Meursault, but clash with Meursault for −20 enemy Clash Power. Check this recipient separately from the Stillness and Thumping Pulse assignments.

phases.6.steps.2.text: All three Excision Coins remain after winning. They deal fixed damage equal to 50% current HP twice and 200% max HP, so use Meursault, whose The Stranger preserves 1 HP. Keep at least one other ally alive.

phases.6.steps.3.text: Winning halves the Chaplain's current Shield and gives him 10 Fragile this turn and next turn. Focus remaining damage. Continue assigning Stillness to the major area skill and Thumping Pulse to Systemwide Ban until the end.

mechanics.0.effect.text: A random Sinner gains it each turn. Phase 1: Final Power +1 and damage +15%. Phases 2 and 3: +2 and +25%. Phase 3 also inflicts 1 Defense Level Down On Hit, up to 9.

mechanics.0.response.text: Handles major area skills in Phases 2 and 3. Being the main target gives the enemy −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power.

mechanics.1.effect.text: A random Sinner gains it each turn. Clash Power +1 / +2 / +3 in Phases 1 / 2 / 3; damage taken −25% / −25% / −50%. Winning against Phase 2 Death Unto the Condemned or Phase 3 Systemwide Ban grants a temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP, removed after the attack. Phase 3 also inflicts 1 Offense Level Down On Hit, up to 9.

mechanics.1.response.text: Can clash with the corresponding Gluttony skill regardless of Speed even when it cannot be redirected normally. Having Thumping Pulse is not enough: you must win.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Granted to Meursault. While at least one other ally is alive, HP cannot fall below 1; damage that would Stagger him removes the threshold instead. Strengthens across phases. In Phase 3, Speed +3, Final Power +3, damage +30%; winning a clash against the Chaplain heals 8 SP and grants 5 total E.G.O resources of affinities with low reserves. Cannot retreat.

mechanics.2.response.text: Handles Shift + Delete at the end. Another ally must remain alive during the fight; do not treat Meursault as immortal when alone.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Starts at 2 in Phase 1. At Turn Start, gain Clash Power Down and Fragile equal to Stack ×4. At Turn End, heal SP and lose 1 Stack.

mechanics.3.response.text: Do not apply his opening weakness to the Power of later Warden or Chaplain phases.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Special Charge. Gain 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Count does not naturally decrease in this battle. In Phase 3, replenish 5 Count at Turn Start if both Potency and Count are below 10; maximum Count rises to 25 / 30 at 5 or more / 10 or more Potency.

mechanics.4.response.text: Distinguish Potency from Count. Emptying Count last turn does not prevent the major attack's buff if it is automatically replenished.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 100. Increases with Preservation Count gained or consumed, and by 10 at Turn End. At 100, changes to Divinity of the Obsidian God next turn.

mechanics.5.response.text: Voice B's Defense Skill raises it to 100. Identify the next Stillness holder and prepare for the major attack.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Increases Offense and Defense Levels based on Stack and makes all skill Coins Unbreakable, excluding Excision Coins. At 0, returns to Voice of the Obsidian God next turn.

mechanics.6.response.text: Expect hits after clash wins; use Stillness and Thumping Pulse for major-skill mitigation and Shields.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Collective term for Phase 2 nails: Hammernail [Condemnation], Hammernail [Judgment], Nail [Punishment], and Nail [Penance]. Changes to the last applied type and combines Stack, but Hammernails do not revert to ordinary Nails.

mechanics.7.response.text: More nails on the recipient strengthen the enemy. Assign Voice B's Sloth skill to a Sinner with few nails.

mechanics.8.effect.text: When activated by the major area skill, deals fixed damage equal to Stack ×5% max HP, minimum 10. Equipping defense at Combat Start halves it and prevents death or Stagger from this effect.

mechanics.8.response.text: If other Sinners besides the Stillness clash recipient have these nails, equip defense to reduce nail damage. The Defense Skill does not need to activate.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Staggers the holder at Turn Start. Thumping Pulse prevents Stagger from this effect; expires at that turn's end.

mechanics.9.response.text: Clash with Death Unto the Condemned using next turn's Thumping Pulse holder.

mechanics.10.effect.text: When activated by the major area skill, gain Sinking equal to Stack. Maximum 9.

mechanics.10.response.text: Check SP after the major skill and restore clashes for the next cycle.

mechanics.11.effect.text: When activated by the major area skill, raise the holder's Stagger Threshold by Stack ×2. Maximum 9.

mechanics.11.response.text: Keep enough HP and distinguish protection from the skill's Stagger damage from separate nail effects.

mechanics.12.effect.text: Collective term for the Chaplain's “~” effects: Nail [Exception], Nail [Breakpoint], and Nail [Console]. Changes to the last applied type and combines Stack, but Exception and Breakpoint do not revert to Console.

mechanics.12.response.text: More nails on the Sinner increase enemy Power and damage. Manage these separately from nails on the skill panel.

mechanics.13.effect.text: Maximum 9. If at 9 at Combat Start, each attack hit on the Chaplain deals fixed self-damage equal to 2% max HP that cannot Stagger the holder. When activated by the major area skill, gain Sinking equal to Stack and raise the Stagger Threshold by Stack ×2.

mechanics.13.response.text: Avoid panel skills pierced by nails to prevent unnecessary extra buildup.

mechanics.14.effect.text: When activated by the major area skill, deals fixed damage equal to Stack ×10% max HP, minimum 10. Equipping defense at Combat Start halves it and prevents death or Stagger from this effect. Maximum 9.

mechanics.14.response.text: For Sinners other than the Stillness clash recipient, also consider equipping defense to reduce nail damage.

mechanics.15.effect.text: At Turn Start, take fixed damage equal to 50% current HP and become Staggered. Thumping Pulse prevents that Stagger and halves the damage. Expires at Turn End after activation.

mechanics.15.response.text: Assign Systemwide Ban to the Thumping Pulse holder. Healing alone does not remove the Stagger condition.

mechanics.16.effect.text: Maximum 25. Damage dealt increases and damage taken decreases by Stack%. Gained from the Chaplain's Preservation Potency above 10. First reaching 33% HP or less consumes it all for a non-decaying Shield equal to (25 + Stack)% max HP and permanent Defense Level loss equal to Stack.

mechanics.16.response.text: After the Shield appears, assign Meursault to Shift + Delete and exploit its clash-win Shield halving and Fragile.

mechanics.17.effect.text: Special Coins that can destroy Unbreakable Coins. They survive their own clash loss and attack with the remaining Coins after receiving attacks.

mechanics.17.response.text: Systemwide Ban and Shift + Delete do not stop after a clash win. Receive them with Thumping Pulse's Shield or Meursault's The Stranger.

warnings.0.text: In Phase 1, do not assign a 1-Speed Sinner to the Warden. Destroy all candles first and use a recipient with at least 2 Speed.

warnings.1.text: Stillness and Thumping Pulse change recipients each turn. Do not fix them to the previous turn's Sinners.

warnings.2.text: A clash win alone is insufficient for Death Unto the Condemned or Systemwide Ban. You need the temporary Shield from winning with Thumping Pulse.

warnings.3.text: Phase 3 penalizes equipping nailed Attack Skills and using Win Rate or Damage auto-selection. Choose manually.

warnings.4.text: The Chaplain fully heals the first time he falls below 50% HP. After halving HP a second time, combat continues without another full heal.

warnings.5.text: Take Shift + Delete with Meursault and keep other allies alive. The Stranger is not unconditional immortality.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Customer Lv. 65. Identities below Uptie III are raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Bridge the gap to enemy Lv. 90 through high-Power skills and Stillness / Thumping Pulse conditions.

preparation.1.text: Prepare HP and SP recovery for a long fight and high-Power E.G.O. Most enemy attacks are Blunt; check Blunt resistance too.

preparation.2.text: Use Meursault for resources from the opening and protect the other Sinners. Enter with SP and resources prepared; save candle resources for later major attacks too.

roles.0.reason.text: The Stranger handles Stagger and lethal damage, including the final Shift + Delete. Requires other allies to remain alive.

roles.1.reason.text: Destroy every candle before the Warden acts. Split main targets instead of relying only on area damage.

roles.2.reason.text: Stillness and Thumping Pulse are random; do not rely on only one Sinner to handle major clashes.

roles.3.name.text: HP and SP recovery and attack debuffs

roles.3.reason.text: Restore clashes weakened by Sinking and nails and keep key Sinners alive through the long battle.
